title: Proposal Created Webhook
description: Compact account-anchored invalidation fired after the seller creates a later proposal and the snapshot is readable through list_proposals. Identifiers only: the payload carries no commercial terms or seller prose, so it cannot inject terms or instructions into a buyer agent. Receivers verify the webhook signature, dedupe by notification_id, and call list_proposals on the seller bound to the notification config, never on an endpoint taken from the body. Experimental (media_buy.open_opportunities): sellers emitting it MUST list the feature id in experimental_features.

idempotency_key.description: Sender-generated delivery key stable across retries of one fire. Deliberate re-emission uses a new key.

notification_id.description: Logical notification identifier. Always equals proposal_id.

parent_proposal_id.description: Present when the later proposal revises an earlier proposal for the same opportunity.

expires_at.description: Copied from the snapshot so the receiver can prioritize the read.

ext.description: Bounded vendor extensions subject to the same identifiers-only rule as the base payload.

examples.description: New event inventory for an open opportunity
